options.description:
The configuration to use for building
the project. The default for most
projects is 'Debug'.

property to use when building the
project.

options.description:
Do not restore the project before
building. [default: False]

options.description:

complete authentication). [default:
False]

options.name: -verbosity
options.description:
Set the MSBuild verbosity level. Allowed
values are q[uiet], m[inimal], n[ormal],
d[etailed], and diag[nostic].

options.name: --output
options.description:
The output directory to place built
artifacts in.

options.name: --artifacts-path
options.description:
The artifacts path. All output from the
project, including build, publish, and
pack output, will go in subfolders under
the specified path.

options.name: --no-incremental
options.description:
Do not use incremental building.
[default: False]

options.name: --no-dependencies
options.description:
Do not build project-to-project
references and only build the specified
project. [default: False]

options.name: --no-logo
options.description:
Do not display the startup banner or the
copyright message. [default: True]

options.name: --self-contained
options.description:
Publish the .NET runtime with your
application so the runtime doesn't need
to be installed on the target machine.
The default is 'false.' However, when
targeting .NET 7 or lower, the default
is 'true' if a runtime identifier is
specified. [default: False]

options.name: --no-self-contained
options.description:
Publish your application as a framework
dependent application. A compatible .NET
runtime must be installed on the target
machine to run your application.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: The target runtime to build for.
